objects.description: During [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051), [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) used the following commands to dump SAM, SYSTEM, and SECURITY hives: reg save hklm\sam, reg save hklm\system, and reg save hklm\security.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity)
objects.description_fa: در طول [APT28 Nearest Neighbor Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0051)، [APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) از دستورات زیر برای تخلیه کندوهای SAM، SYSTEM و SECURITY استفاده کرد: [[[CTI_PRESERVE_0]] و reg save hklm\security.(Citation: Nearest Neighbor Volexity) reg save hklm\sam, reg save hklm\system,
